_doc: The Koreans add-on's OWN texture sets by revision, read by AoP scripts/havok/texture_sets.py (registry_for: the mod a model belongs to) and its gr2_lint checks texture_sets / atlas_regions / tangent_convention. A binding (.material parameter block or a Blender review shader) takes its channels from ONE set (or a declared variant); a retired set is never bound.

paths are art-relative without extension; sha256 = the runtime DDT; preview_sha256 / aliases identify decoded or packaged preview images in Blender scenes; regions = atlas boxes in image pixels (top-left = raw GR2 v); tangent = the GR2 tangent convention of faces on this set. Canonical atlas record: korean-buildings-blender patterns/korean/shared_atlas_r65.json. Moved here from AoP config/texture_sets.json on 2026-10-09 (temporary rule: all Korean content in this repo).
